{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to `src/interfaces/mining.h` are mechanical call-site updates following method signature changes in validation.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch IPC infrastructure or multiprocess mechanics."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies `src/kernel/notifications_interface.h`, `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp`, and removes internal error modes from the kernel C API and C++ wrappers.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Clarifies the kernel boundary error reporting by decoupling fatal operational failures from block validation states. Correctness and explicitness in error propagation across the boundary are core priorities for libbitcoinkernel."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches `src/validation.cpp` for block and chainstate validation functions, not mempool policy or transaction validation rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not touch transaction relay, mempool eviction, fee policy, or standardness rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in `src/node/miner.cpp` and `src/rpc/mining.cpp` mechanically adapt callers to the new `util::Expected` return types.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Template generation logic, fee/weight accounting, and mining interfaces are not substantively altered."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to `src/net_processing.cpp` only update block processing call sites to inspect `util::Expected` return values.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change peer-to-peer transport, protocol messages, or network handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "RPC modifications in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp` and `src/rpc/mining.cpp` follow from updating calls to chainstate functions.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No RPC interfaces, parameter schemas, or JSON outputs are substantively modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates to unit tests, benchmarks, and fuzz harnesses strictly reflect the refactored return signatures of validation methods.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter test frameworks, harness infrastructure, or CI tooling."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits in `src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp` are downstream adjustments to kernel and validation call sites.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Developer or operator tooling logic is unchanged."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the Validation label and directly refactors core chainstate APIs (`ConnectBlock`, `AcceptBlock`, `FlushStateToDisk`, `ProcessNewBlock`) in `src/validation.cpp` and `src/node/blockstorage.cpp`.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Decoupling runtime operational errors from block validation states eliminates a long-standing architectural hazard where non-validating functions took validation state parameters. This retirement of interface ambiguity also unblocks related validation cleanups in #35570."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches `src/wallet/test/wallet_tests.cpp` solely to update mock chainstate calls.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not affect wallet functionality, descriptors, transactions, or persistence."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
